mapper.select: SELECT promo_year AS promoYear, promo_name AS promoName, promo_phase AS promoPhase, promo_identifier AS promoIdentifier, promo_name_sort_id AS promoNameSortId, promo_phase_sort_id AS promoPhaseSortId, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, duration_days AS durationDays FROM ssm_promotion_cfg ORDER BY promo_year, promo_name_sort_id, promo_phase_sort_id
mapper.insert:
insert into ssm_promotion_cfg ( promo_year, promo_name, promo_phase, promo_identifier, promo_name_sort_id, promo_phase_sort_id, start_date, end_date, duration_days ) values
( #{item.promoYear}, #{item.promoName}, #{item.promoPhase}, #{item.promoIdentifier}, #{item.promoNameSortId}, #{item.promoPhaseSortId}, #{item.startDate}, #{item.endDate}, #{item.durationDays} )
mapper.select: SELECT t1.activity_year AS promoYear, t2.`activity_name` AS promoName, t1.`activity_stage` AS promoPhase, CONCAT(t1.activity_year,'-',t2.`activity_name`,'-',t1.`activity_stage`) AS promoIdentifier, t1.`start_date` AS startDate , t1.`end_date` AS endDate, IFNULL(t2.`sort_id`,0) AS promoNameSortId, IFNULL(t1.`sort_id`,0) AS promoPhaseSortId, DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) + 1 AS durationDays FROM bi_mgp.mgp_entity_biz_calendar t1 INNER JOIN bi_mgp.mgp_entity_biz_activity t2 ON t1.`activity_id` = t2.`id` WHERE t1.`is_active` = 1 AND t1.`start_date` IS NOT NULL AND t1.`end_date` IS NOT NULL
